competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times. The first hit decreases Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance and the second hit decreases Attack Power for 2 turns with a 50% chance.
Unleashes a piercing scream, stunning the enemy and inflicting Continuous Damage for 3 turns. This skill receives 50% additional Accuracy.
When using a skill on your turn, attacks the target 2 to 3 more times, each absorbing the Attack Bar by 10%. [Automatic Effect]
